This Is Why You Don't Try To Overtake A Semi Truck Around A Curve During Heavy Fog Conditions
Audio By Carbonatix
A heart-stopping crash on a fog-shrouded mountain road has been caught on camera, showing the split-second mistake that led to a violent head-on collision and left two people hospitalized.
The dramatic footage, shared by Turkish outlet Aykırı, shows a vehicle traveling through near-zero visibility conditions on the treacherous Şavşat-Ardahan road on April 20.
As the camera vehicle, believed to be a truck, moves cautiously through thick fog, visibility is reduced to just a few meters ahead.
Then, in an instant, a car suddenly emerges in the oncoming lane, appearing directly in front of the truck after attempting a dangerous overtaking maneuver.
With no time to react, the two vehicles collide head-on in a violent impact that underscores the deadly risks of driving in such conditions.
Authorities confirmed that two people were injured in the crash and were taken to hospital for treatment. The extent of their injuries has not been disclosed.
